project_title: Graph-Guided Repository Navigation for Coding Agents
research_question: Does graph-guided repository navigation improve source-file retrieval effectiveness compared with lexical search in software repositories?

baseline.name: Lexical Baseline
baseline.description: Ranks repository files using direct lexical query-token matching.

proposed.name: Graph-Augmented Search
proposed.description: Uses direct lexical score plus a weighted one-hop import-neighbor score.

experimental_controls: Both methods use the same pinned repository snapshot.
Both methods use the same 12 independent queries.
Both methods use the same verified target-file labels.
Both methods use the same file collection and preprocessing.
Both methods use the same ranking and tie-breaking policy.
The graph boost is fixed at 0.10 before further evaluation.
No parameter tuning will be performed on the 12-query evaluation set.
limitations: The evaluation uses one Python repository.
The evaluation contains only 12 manually reviewed queries.
The results are exploratory and cannot establish general superiority.
Automated dataset validation does not independently prove semantic correctness of every query-target pair.
No statistical significance claim will be made from this small evaluation.
